paragraph: Moonachie is a small market, and the numbers say so. Three single-family sales over six months, a median of $755,000, and a range from $585,000 to $780,000. The sale-to-list ratio came in at about 0.96 and one of the three sold above asking, while the median days on market was 21. Read that as sellers holding out for their number rather than a market with real leverage on either side, and understand that three closings cannot carry a trend claim. The monthly series is the same story. One sale in February, two in June, nothing else. If Moonachie follows the usual Bergen County seasonal arc, activity thins further through fall. With inventory this limited, what matters more than the countywide picture is what is actually available the week you are ready to move.
